# Fraaza Enterprises Inc.

> Professional hydroseeding, soil preparation, landscaping, and snow plowing in Holland, MI and West Michigan. Owner-operated since 2004.

## About
Fraaza Enterprises Inc. is a hydroseeding and landscaping company serving Holland, Zeeland, Grand Haven, Hudsonville, and surrounding West Michigan communities. Owner-operated by Chad Fraaza since 2004.

## Services
- Hydroseeding (residential, commercial, slopes, roadsides, golf courses, utilities)
- Erosion control and hydromulching
- Soil preparation (grading, amendments, topsoil)
- Landscaping (sod, retaining walls, drain tile, Bobcat services)
- Snow plowing (plowing, salting, sidewalks, loader plowing)
